comparison.objective: Apply an occlusion patch to the correct mannequin eye, unlike commissioning a shock absorber through iterative dynamic adjustment.
comparison.physical_skill: Adhesive-patch pickup, placement, and release; no tool-driven unlocking, collar tuning, or torque-controlled relocking.
comparison.success_condition: Patch within stated eye-distance bands; wrong/both eyes, moved setup, or retained patch fail. No damper-cycle criteria.
comparison.reason: Tests semantic target selection and compliant placement, not mechanical calibration. No separate spec versions or force/damage thresholds are provided.
